name: Bishoujo Ren'ai Mahjong Series: Karan Koron Gakuen: Pure Love Hen
original_name: 美少女恋愛麻雀シリーズ 華蘭虎龍学園 ぴゅあらぶ編
source:
Main character wants to find love, and for that he challenges three new girls in mahjong.
Girl stories have following titles: "When cherry blossoms dance", "You are through the camera lenses" and "The thought of young age".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公想寻找爱情，因此向三名新女孩发起麻将挑战。

女孩故事标题分别是：“樱花起舞时”“透过镜头看见你”以及“年少时的思念”。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
